profile.headline: Software Engineer | DevOps | Master’s in Computer science
profile.summary:
Secret security clearance. Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in Ruby on Rails, ReactJS, Kubernetes, Python/Scikit, Java. Strong research professional with a Master's degree in Computer Science from Texas A&M University. 

Currently working at AOI as an Software Engineer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Under the ODOS 3 contract, I migrated 15 applications from cloud foundry to kubernetes seamlessly without any incidents

Created an automated service that backfill biometric data for a million users using Databricks and Sidekiq queues with a 90% success rate

Deployed and optimized biometric logic to accurately display information to a million users

Deployed a parity check system to match applicants biometric data from multiple stakeholders
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · DevOps · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Technician
positions.description: Delivered technical support and software solutions to over 500 customers monthly, achieving a 95% satisfaction rate and reducing turnaround times by 30% through efficient troubleshooting and process optimization

positions.title: Software Technician
positions.description: Delivered technical support and software solutions to more than 500 customers monthly, achieving a 95% satisfaction rate and reducing turnaround times by 30% through efficient troubleshooting and process optimization.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed a robust machine learning algorithm to differentiate adult and children sketching data
in Python and Java with an 86% accuracy (Java, python)

Collaborate Johnson Space Center to develop an inexpensive robust system
to detect joint angle inside a space suit by fusing the Microsoft Kinect and Inertial Measurement
Units; the degree error was 8.9 from the golden standard (C#, Matlab) A paper of our system was accepted to Body and System Network (BSN) Conference

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Supervised and graded undergraduate’s senior design projects (C++, C#, Ruby, Linux, Python)

Collaborated with Professors and Teaching Assistants to produce multiple 
learning labs and course work for undergraduates (C++)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Improved a system that gamify mathematical proofs using Javascript and Ruby on Rails, resulting
in solving more complex proofs

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Refurbished an existing system to collect and construct raster files from satellite data, which
results in a faster geographical updates in 3rd world countries (Python, ARCgis) My system was used in nepal earthquake disaster in 2015

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Refurbished an existing system to collect and construct raster files from satellite data for natural-disaster prediction, enabling faster geographic updates in developing countries.
